evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Imperative directive enacting authority-ranking: speaker commands erasure of knowledge, performing hierarchical control over what the recipient may retain.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Second imperative command reinforcing authority-ranking: speaker issues a direct order to eliminate held knowledge, enacting unilateral authority over the recipient's cognitive state.
